title: Seoul stocks slide nearly 4% on AI jitters, unrest in France
caption:
South Korea's KOSPI plunged nearly 4 percent as investors unloaded tech heavyweights. Mounting doubts over AI profitability triggered a sharp retreat from leading chipmakers.
